relations.subject: Vsevolod Fëdorovič Miller
relations.evidence: From 1866 studies at Hist.-Philological Faculty of Moscow University, soon moved to Physical-Mathematical Faculty, but still followed Petrov’s Sanskrit teaching. After graduation in spring 1870

relations.subject: Vsevolod Fëdorovič Miller
relations.evidence: conducted fieldwork with Fortunatov in Lithuania, where they collected 150 songs and fairy tales

relations.subject: Vsevolod Fëdorovič Miller
relations.evidence: From 1877 Docent at Moscow, taught Asian history, Sanskrit and comparative IE and Indo-Iranian

relations.subject: Vsevolod Fëdorovič Miller
relations.evidence: From 1897 Director of Lazarevskij Institut in Moscow.

relations.subject: Vsevolod Fëdorovič Miller
relations.evidence: From 1911 ord. Member of Imperial Academy, in Division of Russian language and literature, now moved to St.Petersburg.
